curation.notes: LUMICKS C-Trap dual-trap optical tweezers, constant-trap-position (passive) folding/unfolding equilibrium measurements of the theophylline RNA aptamer (WT and U24C mutant) with DNA handles, with and without theophylline; dwell times classified by an autoregressive HMM. Ligand slows unfolding without changing folding rates.

evidence.snippet: Data is recorded at 78.125 kHz and then downsampled by a factor of 100.
